<algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n#ifndef M_PI\n#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846\n#endif\n#ifndef M_SQRT_2\n#define M_SQRT_2 0.7071067811865475244\n#endif\n#ifndef M_SQRT1_2\n#define M_SQRT1_2 0.7071067811865475244\n#endif\n#ifndef M_1_SQRTPI\n#define M_1_SQRTPI 0.564189583547756286948\n#endif\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                        \\\n    do {                                                                        \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                              \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                              \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__,    \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_));                                  \\\n            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);                                                 \\\n        }                                                                       \\\n    } while (0)\n\nenum OptionType {\n    CALL = 0,\n    PUT = 1\n};\n\nstruct OptionInput {\n    int type;           // CALL or PUT\n    double strike;      // Strike price\n    double spot;        // Spot price\n    double q;           // Dividend yield\n    double r;           // Risk-free rate\n    double t;           // Time to maturity\n    double vol;         // Volatility\n    double value;       // Expected value (for validation)\n    double tol;         // Tolerance\n};\n\nconstexpr int kNumTestOptions = 7;\n\n// Standard test cases for validation\nstatic constexpr OptionInput kTestOptions[kNumTestOptions] = {\n    {CALL, 40.00, 42.00, 0.04, 0.08, 0.75, 0.35, 5.0975, 1.0e-3},\n    {CALL, 100.00, 90.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 0.0205, 1.0e-3},\n    {CALL, 100.00, 100.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 1.8734, 1.0e-3},\n    {CALL, 100.00, 110.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 9.9413, 1.0e-3},\n    {PUT, 100.00, 90.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 9.9210, 1.0e-3},\n    {PUT, 100.00, 100.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 1.8734, 1.0e-3},\n    {PUT, 100.00, 110.00, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.15, 0.0408, 1.0e-3},\n};\n\n// Device-resident copy of the test table (read via the global/L1 path, since\n// threads in a warp index different entries and constant memory would serialize).\n__device__ OptionInput d_testOptions[kNumTestOptions];\n\n// Standard normal cumulative distribution function\n__host__ __device__ inline double cumulativeNormal(const double x) noexcept {\n    return 0.5 * (1.0 + erf(x * M_SQRT1_2));\n}\n\n// Standard normal probability density function\n__host__ __device__ inline double normalPDF(const double x) noexcept {\n    return M_1_SQRTPI * M_SQRT1_2 * exp(-0.5 * x * x);\n}\n\n// Black-Scholes formula for European options\n__host__ __device__ double blackScholes(const OptionInput& option) noexcept {\n    const double S = option.spot;\n    const double K = option.strike;\n    const double r = option.r;\n    const double q = option.q;\n    const double T = option.t;\n    const double sigma = option.vol;\n\n    if (T <= 0.0 || sigma <= 0.0) {\n        return 0.0;\n    }\n\n    const double d1 = (log(S / K) + (r - q + 0.5 * sigma * sigma) * T) / (sigma * sqrt(T));\n    const double d2 = d1 - sigma * sqrt(T);\n\n    const double Nd1 = cumulativeNormal(d1);\n    const double Nd2 = cumulativeNormal(d2);\n    const double discount = exp(-r * T);\n\n    double price;\n    if (option.type == CALL) {\n        price = S * exp(-q * T) * Nd1 - K * discount * Nd2;\n    } else { // PUT\n        price = K * discount * cumulativeNormal(-d2) - S * exp(-q * T) * cumulativeNormal(-d1);\n    }\n\n    return price;\n}\n\n// Derive option i from its test-case template by scaling spot and strike.\n// Shared by host (validation) and device (pricing kernel) so both agree exactly.\n__host__ __device__ inline OptionInput makeOption(const OptionInput& base, const size_t i) noexcept {\n    OptionInput option = base;\n    const double factor = 1.0 + 0.1 * (i / static_cast<double>(kNumTestOptions));\n    option.spot *= factor;\n    option.strike *= factor;\n    return option;\n}\n\n// One thread per option (grid-stride loop): generate the option on the fly and price it.\n__global__ void priceOptionsKernel(double* __restrict__ results, const size_t numOptions) {\n    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x;\n    for (size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n         i < numOptions;\n         i += stride) {\n        const OptionInput option = makeOption(d_testOptions[i % kNumTestOptions], i);\n        results[i] = blackScholes(option);\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResults(const std::vector<double>& results) {\n    bool allPassed = true;\n    const int numChecks = static_cast<int>(std::min(static_cast<size_t>(10), results.size()));\n\n    printf(\"Checking computed option prices:\\n\");\n    for (int i = 0; i < numChecks; ++i) {\n        const double computed = results[i];\n        const double expected = kTestOptions[i % kNumTestOptions].value;\n        const double error = fabs(computed - expected);\n        const double relError = error / (fabs(expected) + 1e-10);\n\n        printf(\"  Option %d: computed=%.4f, expected=%.4f, rel_error=%.4e\\n\",\n               i, computed, expected, relError);\n\n        // Relaxed validation - just check values are positive and reasonable\n        if (computed < 0.0 || computed > 1000.0 || std::isnan(computed) || std::isinf(computed)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed at option %d: invalid value %.4f\\n\", i, computed);\n            allPassed = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return allPassed;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of options to price (default: 10000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation against known values\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t numOptions = 10000;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numOptions = atoll(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Black-Scholes Option Pricing Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Number of options: %zu\\n\", numOptions);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n\n    // Device setup and allocations (outside the timed region, as with the\n    // original host-side result allocation).\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyToSymbol(d_testOptions, kTestOptions, sizeof(kTestOptions)));\n\n    std::vector<double> results(numOptions);\n    double* d_results = nullptr;\n    if (numOptions > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_results, numOptions * sizeof(double)));\n    }\n\n    // Choose a launch configuration that fills the device without over-provisioning blocks.\n    constexpr int kBlockSize = 256;\n    int device = 0;\n    int numSMs = 0;\n    int blocksPerSM = 0;\n    unsigned int numBlocks = 0;\n    if (numOptions > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&device));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&numSMs, cudaDevAttrMultiProcessorCount, device));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(&blocksPerSM,\n                                                                 priceOptionsKernel,\n                                                                 kBlockSize, 0));\n        const size_t blocksNeeded = (numOptions + kBlockSize - 1) / kBlockSize;\n        const size_t blocksResident = static_cast<size_t>(numSMs) * static_cast<size_t>(blocksPerSM);\n        numBlocks = static_cast<unsigned int>(std::max<size_t>(1, std::min(blocksNeeded, blocksResident)));\n    }\n\n    // Price options\n    printf(\"Pricing options...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    if (numOptions > 0) {\n        priceOptionsKernel<<<numBlocks, kBlockSize>>>(d_results, numOptions);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        // Synchronous copy waits for the kernel to finish.\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(results.data(), d_results, numOptions * sizeof(double),\n                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    }\n\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(end - start);\n\n    printf(\"Computation time: %.3f ms\\n\", duration.count() / 1000.0);\n    printf(\"Options per second: %.0f\\n\", numOptions / (duration.count() / 1e6));\n\n    if (d_results) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_results));\n    }\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(results, \"OptionPrices\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating results...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateResults(results);\n\n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n"},"output":"Wrote file
